buxton_crescent_0.text: Welcome to the Crescent. John Carr built it in the 1780s for the 5th Duke of Devonshire.
The curve was inspired by the Royal Crescent in Bath. The Duke wanted Buxton to be the Bath of the north, and it rather worked.
Visitors came to take the waters and to be seen taking them. Today they come for the scones, which is a modern improvement.

buxton_crescent_1.text: They say Mary Queen of Scots came to Buxton for the waters while she was in the care of the Earl of Shrewsbury.
Even a queen needed a spa weekend.
